text: On December 22, 2022, the City received Zoning By-law Amendment and Site Plan Control applications for 2636-2654 Eglinton Avenue West and 1856 and 1856A Keele Street (the "Site") to permit the construction of a 33-storey mixed-use building. The applicant appealed City Council's neglect or failure to make a decision on its applications to the Ontario Land Tribunal on January 24, 2024. The City Solicitor requires further directions for an upcoming Ontario Land Tribunal hearing scheduled to being on May 26, 2025. This matter is urgent and cannot be deferred.

City Council on March 26 and 27, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 13, 2025) from the City Solicitor, as amended by Motion 1 by Councillor Frances Nunziata. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 13, 2025) from the City Solicitor, as amended by Motion 1 by Councillor Frances Nunziata, and Confidential Appendix A to the report (March 13, 2025) from the City Solicitor. 3. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 13, 2025) from the City Solicitor remain confidential at the discretion of the City Solicitor, as it contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege.
